answer_1.quote: We propose PENSIEVE, a novel end-to-end Memory-QA system integrating multimodal memory recording, memory retrieval, and answer generation.
answer_1.outputs: The system generates answers to recall questions based on retrieved memory entries, such as 'Where did I park my car?' or 'Which restaurant was that?'

answer_2.quote: We compare an answer with the ground truth and decide its correctness in three ways: computing the keyword overlaps, LLM-as-a-judge with Llama3.3-70B, and decide if the ground truth is entailed in the generated answer.

answer_3.quote: We use an LLM-based (Llama3.3-70B) auto judge to compare the generated answers with the ground truth answers.

answer_4.quote: For the test sets, we employ human annotators to craft invocation commands and timestamped recall questions for each image, and also to verify the accuracy of each answer
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators verified the accuracy of each answer and made adjustments as needed to ensure high-quality question-answer pairs.
